AI Game Developer (MCP) plugin for games built on the BRUTAL C# framework: runs inside the game process, exposes live game state to AI agents through RQL (query / mutate / schema), captures logs and generates agent skills.

Brutal-MCP extension for Ahwoo.BRUTAL.ImGui: pumps BrutalMcp.Tick() from an ImGui NewFramePre hook, exposes the ImGui context (io, style, windows), ini settings and the ConsoleWindow terminal commands to AI agents through RQL, and discovers the GLFW window behind the main viewport.
Brutal-MCP extension for Ahwoo.BRUTAL.Glfw: exposes GLFW windows (title, position, size, focus, visibility, opacity), monitors and the clipboard to AI agents through RQL.
Brutal-MCP extension for Ahwoo.BRUTAL.Sdl: exposes the SDL windows of the game (title, position, size, flags) to AI agents through RQL.
Brutal-MCP extension for Ahwoo.BRUTAL.Jolt: exposes live Jolt physics to AI agents through RQL.
Brutal-MCP extension for Ahwoo.BRUTAL.Box2D: exposes live Box2D physics to AI agents through RQL.
Brutal-MCP extension for Ahwoo.BRUTAL.Fmod: FMOD Studio (banks, events, live instances, buses, VCAs; play / stop / parameters), exposed to AI agents through RQL.
Brutal-MCP extension for Ahwoo.BRUTAL.RakNet: RakNet peers and connections (pings, statistics, network simulator), exposed to AI agents through RQL.
Brutal-MCP extension for Ahwoo.BRUTAL.Vulkan.Vma: Vulkan Memory Allocator (device, heap budgets, statistics; read-only), exposed to AI agents through RQL.
Brutal-MCP extension for Ahwoo.BRUTAL.RenderDoc: RenderDoc in-application API (captures, trigger capture, replay UI), exposed to AI agents through RQL.

The package to install: a dependency-injection first, domain-driven PDF library for .NET 10 and .NET 11 that merges whole documents or selected pages with every PDF byte read and written in-house. Brings SharpCorePDF.Domain, .Application, .Infrastructure and .DependencyInjection in one step; AddSha…
Application layer for SharpCorePDF: the merging and inspection use cases that orchestrate the domain model against the PDF engine ports.
Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection registration for SharpCorePDF: one AddSharpCorePDF() call wires the merger, the inspector and the PDF engine, with optional configuration binding.

Domain model and contracts for composing PDF documents: the immutable MergePlan aggregate, page selection value objects, document metadata and the merging/inspection ports. Contains no third-party dependencies and performs no I/O.

Self-contained PDF engine for SharpCorePDF: reader (classic cross-reference tables, cross-reference streams and object streams), writer and the merging engine. Depends on nothing but the .NET base class library.
